game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Terrace, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the treasure chest using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The treasure chest reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the treasure chest is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Tavern Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The treasure chest reached with actions_used <= 14.
